items.title: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
items.summary: Anthropic is the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, creating a test for the entire industry.

items.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
items.summary: The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
items.summary: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.

items.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
items.summary: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

items.title: California probing whether China improperly acquired Nvidia technology
items.summary: The probe by California, where the AI chipmaker has its global headquarters, follows former CEO Jensen Huang's departure.

items.title: Judge finds Thomas Markle mentally fit to stand trial on child abuse charges
items.summary: Markle, who has denied possessing images of child sex abuse was deemed competent after an evaluation by a court-appointed psychiatrist.
